Already appreciate that 
Zero-condition:
When or if + simple present + “ , ” + simple present —> something which is generally true
If I study hard, I pass my exams. 
[ if I study hard ] —> if or condition clause 
[ I pass my exams. ] —> result clause 
I pass my exams if I study hard. —> we don’t have “ , “ here.
Do you pass your exams if you study hard?
When people read more than three paragraphs online, they often lose interest.
I go to bed when I am tried.
When it rains, she takes the car to work.
If you don’t want to be here, go home! —> imperative verbs —> ساختار های جمله های امری نیازی به sub ندارن —< این و برام بررسی کن
I always wear sunscreen when it is hot.
If you want to try a free yoga class, visit our studio next Tuesday.
If employees enjoy their job, they work more efficiently. —> effectively = ?
If you don’t feel like walking home, take the underground instead. —> ?
If a city had good public transport, people don’t drive as much.
First-condition:
When or if + simple present + “ , “ + simple future or all modals like may, could, can, might and etc (modals are for present and future) —> future possibility
If I study hard, I will pass my exams.
[ if I study hard ] —> if or condition clause 
[ I will pass my exams. ] —> result clause 
نکته اینجاست که این گرامر حتما باید با زمانبندی مشخص توی جمله بیاد وگرنه نمیشه تصمیم گرفت ک این اتفاق میتونه در اینده رخ بده
Will you pass your exams if you study hard?
When it is sunny, we can go to  the beach.
Could > may > might —> future possibly
First condition: a condition in the present and it is  possible result in the future.
If parents read to their children, they will lean to love books.
I’ll meet you later if I finish work early. —> مثلا در اینجا وجود later باعث استفاده از شرط نوع اول شده
I won’t get hungry if I eat something now.
My aim is important. —> ?
Being successful is something for future not now. —> ?
